narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project structure.
finalText:
**The build passes now.** Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, now `retryCount` | Read new name, fall back to old |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 remaining `WARN` lines are real noise. They flag dead code like `crypto.createCipher` and a circular import.

Next: clean up those 8 warnings if you want a silent build.
